h20.verdict: positive — probability differentiation compounds with horizon

ablation_story.carriers: ivol_60 and ep_ttm carry the discrimination. h10: drop ep_ttm -> 3.76pp (worst cut); minimal pair {ivol_60,ep_ttm} BEATS full core (5.45 vs 4.57). h20: drop ivol_60 -> 4.40pp (worst cut), drop ep_ttm -> 5.38, drop turnover_20 -> 5.38.
ablation_story.redundant: rvol_20 is pure dilution: dropping it helps at every horizon (h20: 7.06 vs core 6.29). max5 ~neutral (its info is inside ivol_60). The vol family (rvol_20/ivol_60/max5) is one factor; ivol_60 is its best single representative.
ablation_story.harmful: beta_60 hurts everywhere (core_beta worse than core at h5/h10/h20, brier skill goes negative).
ablation_story.strev: core+strev helps at h10 (5.11 vs 4.57 rel; abs t2.88) but does not beat dropping rvol_20 at h20; min_pair_strev abs t3.39 at h20 is good but still below abl_no_rvol.
ablation_story.turnover_20: dilutes at h10 (dropping it helps: 5.22 vs 4.57) but contributes at h20 (dropping it hurts: 5.38 vs 6.29) — kept in the best h20 set.
ablation_story.method: ic_weighted ~= ew_signed (7.06 vs 6.54 rel h20); fitted IC weights add a little at h20, nothing at h10. Use ew_signed if simplicity is worth 0.5pp.

regime_conditioning_verdict.answer: NO — empirical_regime does not help the probability layer (same as the magnitude layer).
regime_conditioning_verdict.evidence: h20 best set: empirical_regime s0.3 rel 6.95pp bs 0.00164 vs empirical 7.06pp bs 0.00153 (disc unchanged within noise, no brier gain); under abs target brier skill turns NEGATIVE (s0.5: -0.0047; s0.3: -0.0012) because regime-matched pools shift the level toward small same-regime samples. h10: same pattern; core ew rel s0.5 drops disc to 2.58.
regime_conditioning_verdict.mechanism: calibration variant can only change the LEVEL mapping, not within-date ranks; the level is dominated by the unknowable market move, so conditioning on the CURRENT regime adds variance, not signal.

configs_tried.breakdown: stage1 h10: 9 sets x {ew_signed,ic_weighted} x {rel,abs} = 36; stage2 h5+h20: 9x2 rel x2 horizons + 2 core abs = 38; stage3: min_pair_strev 3 horizons x 2 methods x 2 targets = 12 + regime variants 8 cfg-combos x {s0.3,s0.5} x {rel,abs} h10 = 16 + h20 = 16 + 2 abs baselines = 46

honest_caveats: The claim is RELATIVE discrimination only: top-20% vs bottom-20% by predicted P differ by ~7pp in P(beat the liquid median) over 20d. Brier skill is ~0.0015 — the calibrated LEVEL adds almost nothing beyond the train base rate; date share of up-rate variance and date up-rate range 0.12..0.97 still mean absolute P(up) is mostly the market.

disc_ret ~ 0/negative: stocks with high P(up) do NOT earn more on average. Product must pair this layer (frequency tilt) with final_model.json (magnitude); they are different axes and rank different stocks.

h20 disc t-stats use overlapping windows; honest t on non-overlapping halves is ~1.9-2.1 per half, with effect size unchanged. The shuffle-null z (~6.9) is computed on the same overlapping structure so it is like-for-like.
Weakest subset: removing all 31 up_turbulent test dates leaves 4.71pp t1.70 — direction robust, significance on that thin cut is not.
Best-of-120 selection: expected max null ~3.2pp; observed 7.06pp clears it, but the exact 7.06 number is still an optimistic point estimate; honest expectation going forward is ~5-7pp.

ic_weighted weights are fit on raw forward returns (not the up indicator) — by-design walk-forward via harness; no extra leakage surface was added (all scoring through audited harness.walk_forward, all calibration through audited caliblib).
